recipes._note: OTA-603 — dog-vest (kind 'dog_armor') craft recipes. The vests were authored in dogGear.json but had no source; these make the three open-market tiers craftable (the Legendary Reclaimer Pattern Vest stays drop-only from Reclaimer-aligned kills, per its catalog note). Result names match DOG_GEAR; lookupCraftedItem resolves them to kind 'dog_armor' so the crafted item is equippable on the dog.

MECHANIC-2 (2026-05-25) — scanner recipes so the player can craft the off-hand search tools that gate investigate of mechanical / Aetheric / mud features. Pulse Scanner (Common, INT 3, bias=pulse) reads Sentinel and automaton signatures. Aetheric Scanner (Uncommon, INT 4, bias=aetheric) reads pre-flood Aetheric phenomena. Mud Scanner (Common, INT 3, bias=mud) reads buried mud and silt signatures. Each gates its own noun pool and its own loot pool — OTA-033.

arb119 — REFINE path. Mudstone is Rare and was the hard wall on the starter mud golem + Mud Scanner (both re-tiered to Common mud). Compressing 3 Common Mud Fragments into 1 Mudstone gives every higher-tier mud recipe (Mudstone Bulwark, Hardened-Mudstone gear) a craftable path from the mud you actually forage, instead of an RNG wall.

OTA — Hardened Mudstone had NO recipe (loot-only), walling Mudstone Bulwark + other Hardened-Mudstone recipes behind drops despite the Mudstone refine note promising a craftable path. Per the material lore (fused under Etheric pressure): 2 Mudstone + 1 Aether Dust -> 1 Hardened Mudstone.
